title: JOOP! Homme Eau De Parfum Intense for Men 125ml $33.24 (RRP $76) + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU (Excl. TAS, NT)
body:
Deal: JOOP! Homme Eau De Parfum Intense for Men 125ml $33.24 (RRP $76) + Delivery ($0 Prime/ $59 Spend) @ Amazon AU (Excl. TAS, NT)

[MS Paint] God this fragrance has been around for decades.
[Salesniper] https://www.reddit.com/r/Colognes/s/ac2EzLXbUC
[WwDesi] lol from Reddit
“Oh boy, personally this was my worst ever blind buy smells like a urinal cake or a smoke shop like a very heavy incense smell Edit: it wasn’t the intense version but don’t know how far off they would be to each other“
[spy] I'd rather get a quality dupe from Private Blends.
[Captain Yobbo] Most of the dupes on that site are more expensive!
[shutuptakemymoney101] Nice, I like it and always get complimented when wearing it.
Definitely a good winter fragrance, a bit cloying if your intention is to wear it in summer.
[QuickToThePointless] Joop Homme is one of the last true rockstars.
Looking forward to listening to new QUOTSA album tonight!
[Haulien] The only Joop Homme I've liked is the " Le Parfum " (not the EDP).
This one however, the "Intense", I think is better than the original EDT. The rose note is quite nice, replacing the originals smell with a powdery-floral scent.
Wouldn't recommend as a blind buy.
